page.layout: One page of text: a woodcut ornament border at the top, then the title and subtitle centred, then one column of index lines with blue ruled lines running across them.; Top: fragment of a title line in large capitals, the end of the line cut at left, with a woodcut ornament above. Below it, the end of two further title lines. Right of centre: a table of page references, with a two-part column heading, then one reference per row. Blue ruled lines and blue annotations run through the rows.
page.notes: The blue ruled lines and the blue tint on some lines look like a digitiser's overlay or colour markup, not printed matter; the words beneath them are transcribed. "Deobiectionibus" in the printed line is set without a space; kept as the image shows. "coitrà" in the last italic line is doubtful; it may be a printing error for "contrà". Italic and roman type is read from the scan. The rows are in a table, with the column of numbers on the right. Most entries are in blue ink and look like later manuscript annotation, so they are not transcribed. The printed-looking entries are 2, 10, 21 and 30, and the heading is uncertain. The first title line at top is cut at left, so only its visible end is given.
